# Browser animation runtime

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, vendored without modifying their copyright/license headers.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/

These files are used only by the separate motion studies. The original website and model inspection page do not require this runtime.
